reuse.why: The tree already funnels every provider through linkBankSyncAccount, which receives source, externalAccountId and upgradingId, yet the guard is invoked from each of the five provider wrappers instead of inside that shared flow.

duplication.why: The rule itself is written once, but the same guard call is repeated in five provider functions that already share a common link routine.

placement.why: The check sits in the provider wrappers rather than in the shared linkBankSyncAccount, and the new helper is inserted between linkBankSyncAccount's doc comment and the function, so that comment now describes the guard.

scope.why: Only the guard, its call sites and a release note are added.

maintainability.why: A future provider wrapper must remember to add the guard, which the shared routine would have guaranteed, and the misplaced doc comment misleads readers; checking before findOrCreateBank is a defensible but undocumented reason for the placement.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts: the five link*Account wrappers each call assertBankAccountNotLinked instead of the check living in the shared linkBankSyncAccount they all call

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts defines the rule once and every provider link path calls it, though from the wrappers rather than the shared linkBankSyncAccount
